text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B and C at substantial losses, then bought Stock B again soon after; I should use clear, forward-looking criteria for selling and re-entry rather than react to discomfort or recent price moves.","My account value kept slipping despite periods of little trading, so I should review risk and diversification on a regular schedule instead of assuming that holding is automatically the right choice.","I have often sold winners to lock in gains; I should set position and exit rules in advance and apply them consistently to winners and losers alike."]}
